paragraphs: Foothold Technology sells software for human services agencies, covering case management, client tracking, and treatment planning. The agencies it works with span developmental disabilities, home and community based services, supportive housing, care coordination, and behavioral health.

Billing sits inside the electronic record, so billing for services across an agency runs as a single process. For multi-service agencies it offers a configurable setup for each program. The software is also described as connecting the specialists involved in a client's care. Under HIPAA the company identifies itself as a Business Associate.

Foothold was formed by Marlowe Greenberg, Tom Mitchell and Nick Scharlatt to take software developed at Community Access and make it available to other human services agencies. The company says it now supports hundreds of agencies across the nation, in Guam, and in Puerto Rico. It is a Certified B Corporation and states that it operates to standards of verified social and environmental performance. It also states that it is part of the global Pledge 1% movement, donating 1% of profits. Its timeline notes that Foothold joined Exym and KaleidaCare as part of Alpine Software Group.

quote.text: Foothold Technology was created by human service professionals, for human service professionals.
